form.label: PSIMS / SureView Signal Flow Health - v3 5-Day Baseline TEST
form.description: Adds previous-5-complete-day baseline monitoring for total CloudLink volume, Event 33 received, Event 34 sent and Event 55. Warning >=20% above baseline; Critical >=40%. DB queue panels remain pending schema confirmation.

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | search host IN ("GPWMA00A0001","GPWMA00A0002","GRWMA00A0001","GRWMA00A0002") | stats count by host | sort host | fields host

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ earliest=-5d@d latest=now | bin _time span=1d | stats count as Events by _time | append [| makeresults | eval _time=now() | bin _time span=1d | eval Events=0 | fields _time Events] | stats sum(Events) as Events by _time | eval Today=relative_time(now(),"@d") | eventstats avg(eval(if(_time<Today,Events,null()))) as FiveDayAvg | where _time=Today | eval PercentAbove=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round(((Events-FiveDayAvg)/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(PercentAbove>=40,"CRITICAL",PercentAbove>=20,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".PercentAbove."% | Today=".Events." | Avg=".round(FiveDayAvg,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=33 earliest=-5d@d latest=now | bin _time span=1d | stats count as Events by _time | append [| makeresults | eval _time=now() | bin _time span=1d | eval Events=0 | fields _time Events] | stats sum(Events) as Events by _time | eval Today=relative_time(now(),"@d") | eventstats avg(eval(if(_time<Today,Events,null()))) as FiveDayAvg | where _time=Today | eval PercentAbove=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round(((Events-FiveDayAvg)/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(PercentAbove>=40,"CRITICAL",PercentAbove>=20,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".PercentAbove."% | Today=".Events." | Avg=".round(FiveDayAvg,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=34 earliest=-5d@d latest=now | bin _time span=1d | stats count as Events by _time | append [| makeresults | eval _time=now() | bin _time span=1d | eval Events=0 | fields _time Events] | stats sum(Events) as Events by _time | eval Today=relative_time(now(),"@d") | eventstats avg(eval(if(_time<Today,Events,null()))) as FiveDayAvg | where _time=Today | eval PercentAbove=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round(((Events-FiveDayAvg)/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(PercentAbove>=40,"CRITICAL",PercentAbove>=20,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".PercentAbove."% | Today=".Events." | Avg=".round(FiveDayAvg,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=55 earliest=-5d@d latest=now | bin _time span=1d | stats count as Events by _time | append [| makeresults | eval _time=now() | bin _time span=1d | eval Events=0 | fields _time Events] | stats sum(Events) as Events by _time | eval Today=relative_time(now(),"@d") | eventstats avg(eval(if(_time<Today,Events,null()))) as FiveDayAvg | where _time=Today | eval PercentAbove=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round(((Events-FiveDayAvg)/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(PercentAbove>=40,"CRITICAL",PercentAbove>=20,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Result=Status." | ".PercentAbove."% | Today=".Events." | Avg=".round(FiveDayAvg,0) | fields Result

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ earliest=-10d@d latest=now | timechart span=1d count as Events | streamstats window=5 current=f avg(Events) as FiveDayAvg | eval Variance=Events-FiveDayAvg | eval PercentAbove=if(FiveDayAvg>0,round((Variance/FiveDayAvg)*100,1),null()) | eval Status=case(isnull(FiveDayAvg),"BASELINE BUILDING",PercentAbove>=40,"CRITICAL",PercentAbove>=20,"WARNING",true(),"NORMAL") | eval Date=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d") | table Date Events FiveDayAvg Variance PercentAbove Status | sort - Date

chart.title: Daily CloudLink Volume vs 5-Day Moving Baseline

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ earliest=-10d@d latest=now | timechart span=1d count as DailyEvents | streamstats window=5 current=f avg(DailyEvents) as FiveDayAvg | fields _time DailyEvents FiveDayAvg

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | stats count(eval(EventCode=33)) as received count(eval(EventCode=34)) as sent count(eval(EventCode=55)) as event55 latest(_time) as last_seen | eval age_min=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1) | eval health=case(isnull(last_seen),"UNKNOWN", age_min>=10,"NO DATA", received>0 AND sent>0,"ACTIVE", received>0 AND sent=0,"CHECK", true(),"UNKNOWN") | fields health
index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=33 | stats count as received
index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=34 | stats count as sent
index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode=55 | stats count as event55
index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | stats latest(_time) as last_seen | eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1) | fields minutes_since

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ (EventCode=33 OR EventCode=34) | eval Flow=case(EventCode=33,"Received",EventCode=34,"Sent") | timechart span=5m count by Flow

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ EventCode IN (33,34,41,48,49,55) | eval EventMeaning=case(EventCode=33,"33 - Message Received",EventCode=34,"34 - Message Sent",EventCode=41,"41 - Tunnel Requested",EventCode=48,"48 - Tunnel Stopped",EventCode=49,"49 - Tunnel Ended",EventCode=55,"55 - Review Event") | timechart span=5m count by EventMeaning limit=10

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" | search host IN ("GPWMA00A0001","GPWMA00A0002","GRWMA00A0001","GRWMA00A0002") | search host=$host_tok$ | stats count(eval(EventCode=33)) as Received count(eval(EventCode=34)) as Sent count(eval(EventCode=41)) as TunnelRequested count(eval(EventCode=48)) as TunnelStopped count(eval(EventCode=49)) as TunnelEnded count(eval(EventCode=55)) as Event55 latest(_time) as LastSeen by host | eval Delta=Received-Sent | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort host

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | search (EventCode=55 OR Message="*invalid_signal*" OR Message="*Failed to decode signal*" OR Message="*Timeout*" OR Message="*exception*" OR Message="*failed*" OR Message="*error*") | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table EventTime host EventCode Type Message | sort - EventTime

chart.title: Known Signal / Communication Codes Observed in Message

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" host=$host_tok$ | rex field=Message max_match=0 "(?i)(?<SignalCode>s007|aBU|rBU|aPN|rPN|s016|s017|s072|s073|s087|s121|aSV|rSV|tSV|tA1|rA1|dA1)" | mvexpand SignalCode | stats count by SignalCode | sort - count

index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" host=$host_tok$ | search Message="*s016*" OR Message="*s072*" OR Message="*s087*" OR Message="*aBU*" OR Message="*aPN*" OR Message="*invalid_signal*" OR Message="*Timeout*" | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table EventTime host SourceName EventCode Type Message | sort - EventTime

table.title: Recent CloudLink Events - Raw Diagnostic View

search.query: index=winos source="WinEventLog:Application" SourceName="CloudLink.Client" host=$host_tok$ | eval EventTime=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval Meaning=case(EventCode=33,"Message Received",EventCode=34,"Message Sent",EventCode=41,"Tunnel Requested",EventCode=48,"Tunnel Stopped",EventCode=49,"Tunnel Ended",EventCode=55,"Review Event 55",true(),"Other") | table EventTime host EventCode Meaning Type Message | sort - EventTime

html.p: This test version intentionally does not fabricate queue depth, oldest queued signal, drain rate, or stalled-signal metrics. Those panels will be added after the DB table and timestamp/status columns are confirmed.
Important: Event 55 is shown as "Review Event" until its exact semantics are validated from the raw messages/vendor documentation.
